notes.title: First Major Update! OST on Sale NOW!
notes.content:
Dear Researchers in HERE,

Thank you for your patience. 

After more than a month of polishing, we’re excited to bring you this major update. This update includes major enhancements to the main game, along with the release of the original soundtrack, which is available as a separate purchase. Here’s what’s new:

Three New Simulation Levels Added to Training Mode:

Sync Chip02、Sync Chip03、Hacking Pratice03 will unlock once the Sync Chip skill is acquired.

All-New First-Person Mode for Aiming:

Now players can press R1/RB while aiming to switch to a first-person view.

More MORE appearances:

After meeting Rika, MORE will appear during loading screens (can be 100% triggered by restarting the checkpoint); additional appearances occur in New Game+.

Mini-Map Added in New Game+:

Toggle on/off via Options -> HUD -> Minimap.

Skill Try-on Now Available in Mod.EXE Interface:

Try out certain skills before unlocking them or familiarize yourself with new mechanisms after unlocking them!

In the modexe interface, hold Triangle/Y on the following skill icons to enter test mode: 1) Virus container 2) Vulnerability hacker 3) Proxy 4) Sync Chip. 

This concludes the update. If you have any feedback or suggestions, please let us know! We'll continue to improving the game based on them.

Thanks!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.07
notes.content:
Hello players,

In the last week of October, the Genies in Evotinction have donned their Halloween costumes, so don’t let them catch you! Additionally, there are some QoL improvements and bug fixes. Wish you all a smooth stealth experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505859/0a575f84938115c0c8c54a6463dd5e2fabdb5a12.jpg[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes v1.07[/h2]

[h3]Holiday Update[/h3]
Added Halloween costume for the Genies!

[h3]Usability Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Supported more screen aspect ratios.
[*] Optimized map loading—exploring feels safer now.
[*] Improved the disappearing logic for collectible hints—good news for perfectionists.
[*] Optimized the occlusion tolerance for the little cart transporting containers—no more worries about missing a bit of visibility that could get you caught.
[*] Enhanced the tutorial guidance for the reflection mode (slow-motion when detected).
[*] Improved the visual effects when the geological scanner's movement module is hacked.
[*] Enhanced the visual representation of regional synchronization effects.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with incorrect splitting of subtitles.
[*] Resolved potential misrepresentation of game completion percentage.
[*] Fixed subtitles in levels not disappearing after completing simulated training.
[*] Corrected the malfunctioning smoke alarm in the “Retrieve Data” training simulation.
[*] Fixed timing issues for the “Firewall Not Installed” prompt.
[*] Resolved lighting errors that could occur in the Nature Hall.
[*] Fixed potential loss of abilities when dying due to network downtime.
[*] Corrected logical errors in controls during the Queen Bee boss fight.
[*] Fixed issues with DLC costumes not being applied in certain cutscenes.
[/list]

That’s all for now; we look forward to your valuable feedback!

October 29, 2024  
Spikewave Games & Astrolabe Game

notes.title: EVOTINCTION is now officially Released!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your patience! We're thrilled to announce that EVOTINCTION is now officially available on Steam. Developed with Unreal Engine 4, the game features full voice acting and supports advanced PC features like DLSS and ray tracing for an enhanced experience.

While it’s possible to rush through levels with the resources at hand, the game emphasizes and encourages stealthy gameplay. With a bit of strategic thinking and careful study of the environment, Dr. Thomas Liu can navigate the seemingly impenetrable digital fortress without having to confront the patrolling rogue AI robots. Our goal is to offer a unique and immersive experience through this approach.

Here are a few key points we’d like to highlight:

[list]
[*] The Day-One Limited Edition includes a handy resource pack to help Dr. Liu infiltrate the facility with ease, along with unique cosmetic items like the exclusive Panda Suit camouflage. The original soundtrack (OST) will also be arriving later, so stay tuned!
[*] The PC version comes with several new features, so we encourage you to explore and experiment with them as you progress. If you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out—we welcome you to join our Discord community to share your feedback, ask questions, or just chat about the game.
[*] To achieve 100% completion, multiple playthroughs (2+) will be necessary. Don’t worry if you miss items like photos or recordings during your first run—your progress will carry over into New Game+.
[*] The game features full English voice acting, led by Donna Burke, known for her work in the Metal Gear Solid series. We hope you enjoy the incredible performances!
[*] Steam Deck is currently supported, though not yet fully optimized. We will continue to improve compatibility through future updates.
[*] Lastly, we are committed to patching and optimizing the game over time. If you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to leave a message on our Discord https://discord.gg/8CexMWB92d or the Steam Discussion forum. We’re actively listening to the community and working to make the game even better based on your input.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the experience and wish you success as you infiltrate the AI-controlled digital fortress to save humanity!

Best regards,
Spikewave Games & Astrolabe Games

notes.title: Steam-exclusive Camouflage Costume Revealed
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We’re excited to unveil a brand-new teaser featuring our Doctor in his next-gen camouflage—the exclusive PANDA Suit!

[previewyoutube=aunpKwoYvks;full][/previewyoutube]

This special costume will be available only on PC via Steam and is included as a bonus with the "Day-Onw Limited Edition".

[h3]Here’s what the Day-One Limited Edition includes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] EVOTINCTION (full game)
[*] Beginner Boost Pack – Get a head start on unlocking skills and upgrades
[*] Early Unlockable Skills – Access skills typically available in "New Game+" right from the start (in-game resources still required)
[*] Costume Pack – An additional color option for your outfit
[*] Special Costume: The PANDA Suit – Perfect for all animal lovers!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505859/1ff35f7c69ebc7323d146841b1d6871850e592e1.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support!

Cheers,
Dev & Publishing Team of EVOTINCTION
